title: Implement Automatic HTTPS Redirect
description: This feature redirects HTTP requests to HTTPS, ensuring a secure connection for users and protecting against man-in-the-middle attacks. It will be implemented using a middleware function that checks the request protocol and redirects to HTTPS if necessary. This improves the overall security of the framework
testCases: Test HTTP request redirect to HTTPS
acceptance: The feature is accepted when all HTTP requests are successfully redirected to HTTPS and no redirects occur for existing HTTPS requests
reason: Enhancing security is a high-impact improvement for the framework, aligning with the recent stability-focused development and the need for feature development
